title: A card from Jimmy / He says he ...
subtitle: 吉米寄来的明信片 / 他说他……

lead.question: 祖母耳背，你把明信片上的话念给她听、她听不清，你该怎么把书面的话一句句「转述」出来？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象祖母收到孙子的明信片却看不清字，让你念给她听。你念出原话（直接引语）："I have just arrived in Scotland." 她没听清，你只能提高嗓门换一种说法（间接引语）：He says he's just arrived in Scotland.——把 I 换成 he，把原话套进 He says (that) ...。本课 Mary 念卡片、祖母不断问 Eh? / The what? / What?，笑点就在「转述 vs 原话」的反复切换上。
goals: 理解直接引语与间接引语的区别，并能在 He says (that) ... 中正确转换人称与时态
掌握现在完成时 just（刚刚）：I have just arrived in ...
能用 Speak up. 要求对方大声说话；会用附加疑问句 He doesn't say very much, does he?
认识 Youth Hostel / Y.H.A.（青年招待所／青招协）等旅行词汇
lead.summary: 第 101 课祖母让 Mary 念 Jimmy 的明信片：他刚到苏格兰，住在一家青年招待所，很快会写信来，祝大家身体好。祖母耳背听不清，Mary 只好用 He says he ... / He hopes we are all well 反复转述。第 102 课集中操练间接引语：把 She has shut the door. 转述成 She says (that) she has shut the door.，覆盖现在完成时、将来时、情态动词等。
lead.tips: ① 引述动词用现在时（says/hopes）时，间接引语可用现在时、现在完成时和将来时；② 直接引语里的 I/we/you/our 在转述时按新视角改为 he/she/they/we；③ speak up = 大声说、说清楚一点；④ He doesn't say very much, does he? 是反意疑问句，前否后肯，回答按事实用 Yes/No；⑤ Y.H.A. = Youth Hostels Association 青年招待所协会。

questions.q: Does Grandmother seem pleased to get a card from Jimmy? Why/Why not?
questions.zh: 收到吉米寄来的明信片，祖母是否显得高兴？为什么？
questions.a: Not really. She has trouble hearing and finds the card too short — 'He doesn't say very much, does he?'
questions.aZh: 算不上高兴。她听不清，还嫌明信片写得太短——「他没写许多，是吗？」
questions.hint: 听 Is that all? He doesn't say very much, does he?

questions.q: Where has Jimmy just arrived, and where is he staying?
questions.zh: 吉米刚到哪儿？他现在住在什么地方？
questions.a: He has just arrived in Scotland and he's staying at a Youth Hostel.
questions.aZh: 他刚到苏格兰，现在住在一家青年招待所。
questions.hint: 明信片的第一句：I have just arrived in Scotland and ...

questions.q: What does Jimmy say he will do soon?
questions.zh: 吉米说他很快会做什么？
questions.a: He says he'll write a letter soon.
questions.aZh: 他说他很快会写一封信来。
questions.hint: 明信片第二句：I'll write a letter soon.

questions.q: Why does Mary repeat everything in indirect speech?
questions.zh: 为什么玛丽要把每句话都改成间接引语重复一遍？
questions.a: Because Grandmother is old and can't hear her well — she asks 'Eh?' and 'Speak up', so Mary repeats the card's words louder with 'He says he ...'.
questions.aZh: 因为祖母年纪大、听不清，一直问 Eh?，让 Mary 大声点，Mary 只好提高嗓门用 He says he ... 转述。
questions.hint: 注意祖母的 Eh? / What? / Speak up。

questions.q: In 'He hopes we are all well', why does 'you' become 'we'?
questions.zh: 原话是 I hope you are all well，转述成 He hopes we are all well——为什么 you 变成了 we？
questions.a: In indirect speech pronouns change with the speaker's point of view. Jimmy's 'you' refers to his family; when Mary retells it, from her side that 'you' is 'we'.
questions.aZh: 转述时人称要随说话人的视角改变：吉米写的是 you（你们），Mary 替家里人转述时，从她这边看就是 we（我们）。
questions.hint: 想想站在谁的角度说话。

questions.q: 把 'She has shut the door.' 转述给别人：She says that ...
questions.zh: 第 102 课操练：用 He/She/They say(s) (that) ... 转述（重点练现在完成时与将来时）。
questions.a: She says (that) she has shut the door.
questions.aZh: 她说她已经把门关上了。
questions.hint: says 后的从句用现在完成时，人称不变（she 还是 she）。

examples.en: I have just arrived in Scotland.

meanings.usage: write much on a card 在明信片上写很多

examples.en: Read Jimmy's card to me please, Mary.
examples.zh: 请把吉米的明信片念给我听听，玛丽。

examples.en: I'm staying at a Youth Hostel.
examples.zh: 我现住在一家青年招待所。

meanings.usage: a Youth Hostel 一家青年招待所

examples.zh: 他说他住在一家青年招待所。

meanings.usage: the Youth Hostels Association（Y.H.A.）青年招待所协会

examples.en: He's a member of the Y.H.A. — the Youth Hostels Association.
examples.zh: 他是「青招协」的一个成员。

examples.en: He says he'll write a letter soon.

meanings.usage: 不规则动词：write—wrote—written；write to sb 给某人写信

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.en: Read Jimmy's card to me please, Mary.
lines.zh: 请把吉米的明信片念给我听听，玛丽。

lines.speaker: MARY
lines.en: "I have just arrived in Scotland and I'm staying at a Youth Hostel."
lines.zh: 「我刚到苏格兰，我现住在一家青年招待所。」

lines.speaker: MARY
lines.en: He says he's just arrived in Scotland. He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel. You know he's a member of the Y.H.A.
lines.zh: 他说他刚到苏格兰。他说他住在一家青年招待所。你知道，他是「青招协」的一个成员。

lines.speaker: MARY
lines.en: The Y.H.A., mother. The Youth Hostels Association.
lines.zh: 「青招协」，妈妈。青年招待所协会。

lines.speaker: MARY
lines.en: "I'll write a letter soon. I hope you are all well."
lines.zh: 「我很快会写信的。祝你们大家身体都好。」

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.en: What? Speak up, Mary. I'm afraid I can't hear you.
lines.zh: 什么？玛丽，大声一点。我可听不见你念的。

lines.speaker: MARY
lines.en: He says he'll write a letter soon. He hopes we are all well. "Love, Jimmy."
lines.zh: 他说他很快会写信的。他祝我们大家身体好。「谨此问候，吉米。」

lines.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
lines.en: Is that all? He doesn't say very much, does he?
lines.zh: 就这些吗？他没写许多，是吗？

lines.speaker: MARY
lines.en: He can't write very much on a card, mother.
lines.zh: 在明信片上他写不了很多，妈妈。

drill.zh: 他/她/他们说……（重点操练现在完成时、将来时与情态动词的转述）

slots.en: he — "I have put on his coat."

slots.en: they — "We have spoken to the boss."
slots.zh: 他们 — 「我们已和老板谈过。」

answers: She says (that) she has shut the door.
He says (that) he has put on his coat.
He says (that) he will sell his house.

exercises.a: I have just arrived in Scotland.
exercises.note: just 常与现在完成时连用，放在 have 与过去分词之间。

exercises.q: 转述：'I'll write a letter soon.'（他说）
exercises.a: He says (that) he'll write a letter soon.
exercises.note: 引述动词是现在时，从句可保留将来时；I→he。

exercises.q: 转述：'I have shut the door.'（她说）
exercises.a: She says (that) she has shut the door.
exercises.note: 现在完成时转述保持不变，只看人称。

exercises.q: 改错：He says he's staying in a Youth Hostel.
exercises.a: He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel.
exercises.note: stay at + 住所，表示「住在某处」。

exercises.q: 补全附加疑问句：He doesn't say very much, ____?
exercises.note: 前句是否定，附加部分用肯定；do 问 do 答。

exercises.q: 汉译英：大声一点，我听不见你。
exercises.a: Speak up, Mary. I'm afraid I can't hear you.
exercises.note: speak up = 大声说、说清楚一点。

exercises.q: 转述：'I must wait for a bus.'（他说）
exercises.a: He says (that) he must wait for a bus.
exercises.note: 引述动词现在时时，must 在从句中保留。

quiz.q: I have just arrived in Scotland. 中 just 表示：
options: 刚刚（与现在完成时连用）
quiz.note: just「刚刚」常放在 have/has 与过去分词之间。

quiz.q: He says he's staying at a Youth Hostel. 属于：
quiz.note: 原话套进 He says (that) ... 就是间接引语。

quiz.q: 转述 'I hope you are all well.'（玛丽替家人说）应是：
options: He hopes we are all well.
He hopes you are all well.
He hope we are all well.
He hopes we was all well.
quiz.note: 转述时人称随说话人视角变：I→he，you（你们）→we。

quiz.q: He doesn't say very much, does he? 的回答，若他确实写得少，应说：
quiz.note: 反意疑问句按事实回答：事实是否定就用 No, he doesn't.
speak up 是固定说法：大声说、说清楚一点。

options: the Youth Hostels Association（青年招待所协会）
quiz.note: Y.H.A. = Youth Hostels Association，吉米是其成员。

grammar.title: 直接引语与间接引语
grammar.structure: 直接引语："I have just arrived..." → 间接引语：He says (that) he has just arrived...
grammar.definition: 直接引语是原封不动引用原话（放引号内）；间接引语是把原话转述成宾语从句。转述时人称要随说话人视角改变（I→he/she，you→we/they）。
grammar.usage: 引述动词是现在时（says/hopes）时，间接引语可用现在时、现在完成时和将来时。

examples.en: He says he has just arrived in Scotland.
He hopes we are all well.
examples.zh: 他希望我们大家身体都好。

grammar.title: 现在完成时 + just
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + just + 过去分词
grammar.definition: just（刚刚）常与现在完成时连用，表示动作刚发生不久，强调对现在的影响。
grammar.usage: I have just arrived in Scotland.

examples.en: I have just arrived in Scotland.
She has just shut the door.

grammar.title: 反意疑问句（附加疑问句）
grammar.structure: 前句（肯定/否定）+ 简短附加问句（否定/肯定）
grammar.definition: 附加疑问句前后两部分的时态、人称和数要一致；回答要按事实：事实肯定用 Yes，事实否定用 No。
grammar.usage: He doesn't say very much, does he? — No, he doesn't.
